entities.summary: Nikolay Vasilyevich Rudanovsky was a Russian marine officer and explorer, notable for leading several expeditions in 1853–54 to survey and to map the southern part of Sakhalin. In particular, he became the first European cartographer who surveyed inland areas of the island.
